[[File:SignalDroid-StarTours_figure.jpg|A signal droid|thumb|250px|right]]
{{Quote|Landing guidance droid LG318 to incoming vessel: I am programmed to guide inbound ships to public landing platforms. Please follow my vector.|LG318|<ref name="RA">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Signal droids''' or '''landing guidance droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used to direct [[Starship/Legends|starships]] during takeoff and landing at [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]].<ref name="Hasbro 1">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=STAR TOURS Travel Agency|altlink=https://www.jeditemplearchives.com/content/modules.php?name=JReviews&rop=showcontent&id=1021}}</ref> The [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency used this type of droid.<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> [[LG3-18]] was a landing guidance droid stationed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], who guided ships to public landing platforms.<ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The signal droid appears in one of two possible opening scenes of the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' attraction, in the scene featuring [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ST2" /> It is colored primarily red in the ride, though the second version of the action figure based on the droid features blue instead.<ref name="Hasbro 2">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=STAR TOURS Search for the Rebel Spy|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Disney_Parks_Star_Tours_Search_For_The_Rebel_Spy.asp}}</ref> This droid appears to be based on the [[INS-444 window installation droid]].
